body:
bnsisINV 📦

A high-performance inventory management utility for Minecraft 1.21.1, built on Java 21.

Unlike standard inventory viewers, bnsisINV implements a secure Request-Accept-Deny workflow, ensuring player privacy while maintaining administrative oversight.
✨ Key Features

    Request System: Players must approve inventory inspections via /invaccept.
    GUI-Based Viewing: Clean, intuitive interface for browsing player items.
    Modern Stack: Fully optimized for Java 21 virtual threads and 1.21.1 API.
    Open Source: Licensed under GPLv3 for the community.

🛠️ Commands

    /invrequest <player> - Send an inspection request.
    /invaccept - Accept an incoming request.
    /invdeny - Deny an incoming request.
